observation_fields.meaning: 384 actor slots, nine fields each: x/47,y/31,team/23,tool/3,stone/3,fuel/3,health/100,marker,alive/presence. Invisible slots zero.
7x7 dy-major patch (-3..3): each cell tiles/8,water/6,heat/8,support/24,in-bounds-and-alive. Other cells zero.

task.objective: Commission twenty-four settlements by lifting stone with a separate brake operator, then warming each delivered-load workshop for eight working ticks. Protect crews and shared routes.
task.natural_termination: All twenty-four workshops have eight warm commissioned ticks, or no settler remains alive; otherwise H=896. Dropped loads remain failed and can leave the objective unfinished.
task.interaction: A separate brake changes whether an actual moving load lands or blocks a route. Carried heat protects against cold and commissions workshops, while melting ice creates south-flowing water that weakens support and injures downstream actors. Physical resource handoffs and warning markers connect crews.
task.observation_access: Self fields plus Chebyshev radius-three local map/entity fields; no within-square occlusion. Hidden rows and outside-map patch cells zero with presence. Dynamic remote state is not observed. Event rendering must suppress hidden entity events; debug/full-state view is separate. The explicitly listed own team score summaries are self information.

native_control.ownership: External platform may assign any one/multiple actor rows to humans or policies at native step boundaries. Ownership never changes the transition.
